theorems.name: Submission.p05_di_antipode_adjugate_a5b449214a
theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (n : ℕ) (c : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) H) (hΔ : ∀ i j : Fin n, Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (c i j) = ∑ l : Fin n, TensorProduct.tmul k (c i l) (c l j)) (hε : ∀ i j : Fin n, Coalgebra.counit (R := k) (c i j) = if i = j then (1 : k) else 0), ∃ u : H, Matrix.det c * u = 1 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin n, HopfAlgebra.antipode k (c i j) = u * Matrix.adjugate c i j
